checks.name: explicit representative offer requires reviewed organization, existing member and owner; no authority before acceptance
accepted trade representative buys and pays company stock without scout membership; invoice scope stays separate
accepted invoice grant creates and recovers the same request; delegates cannot manage membership or self-review
another company and header mismatch cannot inherit order, invoice, grant or pagination authority
scope revocation blocks reads, downloads and old checkout replay while retaining invoice authority and original contract
expired, suspended and removed memberships stop grants; rejoining does not restore old authority
declined, revoked pending and stale authority changes cannot activate; replay cannot issue a duplicate grant
independent handlers issue the delegated request; invoice withdrawal blocks the file, old write and recovery
revocation during private attachment transport prevents returning already-read bytes

limits: Synthetic organization qualification, identity and payment receipt; no real service, UI, legal representative replacement or independent acceptance.
Acceptance and grants are HTTP; payment preparation/receipt and membership transitions are repositories; expiry and suspensions are isolated administrative fixtures.
